FlowerPainter.Landfill.Name: Landfill
FlowerPainter.Recipe.Landfill.Descriptio: A terraformed waste mound with a working face, gas wells and a haul road — or a capped hill, compost yard, recycling centre or fly-tip.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.style.Tooltip: Active tip, a finished capped hill, a compost yard, a recycling centre or an illegal dump.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.moundHeight.Toolt: Height of the waste mound. Sides are kept near 1 in 3, so small sites get lower mounds. Permanent.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.moundSize.Tooltip: How much of the site the mound covers; the rest is the toe band with the haul road and lagoon.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.fill.Tooltip: How much waste lies about: on the face, in the bays, in the dumps.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.workingFace.Toolt: The open flank where waste is tipped and compacted, cut into the side facing the gate.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.coverPiles.Toolti: Soil piles beside the face for the daily cover.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.litterFences.Tool: Portable screens round the face that catch blowing litter.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.windrows.Tooltip: Long parallel compost rows on the pad.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.skips.Tooltip: Recycling yard: public drop-off skips along the drive-through loop.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.gasVents.Tooltip: Landfill-gas wells in a grid on the finished part of the mound.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.summitPath.Toolti: A footpath that spirals up the mound to benches and a viewpoint at the top.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.meadow.Tooltip: Low bushes on the cap. No trees on the mound: roots would breach the cap.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.toeTrees.Tooltip: A ring of trees round the foot of the mound.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.leachatePond.Tool: A fenced, lined lagoon at the lowest free spot of the toe.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.fence.Tooltip: A sound fence, none, or a broken one with missing panels.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.screenTrees.Toolt: A belt of trees just inside the fence.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain texture under the face, piles and dumps. Permanent.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.paintLayer.Toolti: Which of the map's terrain textures (1–4) to paint with.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.grime.Tooltip: Dirt and puddle decals per 100 m², gathered round the waste and on the roads.
FlowerPainter.Landfill.Issue.MoundTooSma: The site is too small or narrow for a mound; it was planned flat.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.SkipRow.Name: Skip row
FlowerPainter.AddOn.SkipRow.where.Toolti: Along a straight stretch of the outline, or freestanding in the open.
